title: Quantum f-divergences from retrodictive tests: a unifying classical variational principle
summary: The same classical f-divergence admits inequivalent extensions to quantum states. The question is whether these extensions can be obtained from a common classical variational principle with an operational interpretation. Here we generalize Matsumoto's reverse-test optimization by introducing retrodictive tests relative to a reference state. A retrodictive test compares a forward and a reverse stochastic process, realized by quantum preparation and measurement, related by Petz transposition relative to the chosen reference, and subject to prescribed quantum averages.
